description: parity-telephony-controller's log events (log-record.v1, parity-contracts CONVENTIONS "Logging"; started from logging/examples/ of parity-contracts 0.13.0, owned here). Every TC log call names one of these, or a common one (logging/events.common.v1.json), with addKeyValue("event", "<name>"); a record without one is log.unclassified, in no catalogue, so scripts/ci.sh's contract-check fails it. Call-scoped records carry the xsid (the interaction id, a UUIDv7) and the tenant.

arrival.accept_failed.description: freeswitch couldn't take an accepted arrival's hook (ESL unavailable): the dialplan's safety hangup ends the call (503).

arrival.backstop_delete_failed.description: A claimed arrival's backstop hangup couldn't be deleted (ESL unavailable).

arrival.backstop_missing.description: An arrival's safety hangup wasn't there to delete when it was claimed (R1-4): counted, alerted, the claim refused.

arrival.duplicated.description: An arrival for an interaction that already has a session on another leg: refused with 503 (counted).

arrival.refuse_failed.description: An arrival TC refuses couldn't be answered 503 (ESL unavailable); its safety hangup ends it.

cdr_file.list_failed.description: freeswitch's CDR directory couldn't be listed.

cdr_file.read_failed.description: A freeswitch CDR file couldn't be read or parsed; skipped.

channel.kill_failed.description: A channel couldn't be killed (ESL unavailable).

channel.refuse_failed.description: A channel couldn't be answered with a refusal (ESL unavailable).

channel_snapshot.failed.description: The channel snapshot after an ESL (re)connect failed: not ready yet; retried with a backoff.

delivery.dropped.description: Unacknowledged events of a session were dropped by the delivery limits (counted); IE resyncs from the gap. Once per session.

digits.off_failed.description: A leg's digit reporting couldn't be turned off in parity-ms (at its collection's deadline: warn; at a fence raise, PCI: error, counted); TC's side is off.

drain.completed.description: The drain finished in time: the drained file is written (attrs.file, attrs.drain_ms).

drain.failed.description: The drain didn't finish in time (attrs.waiting_for) or failed: no drained file; the exit code is 1.

drained_file.failed.description: Drained, but the drained file couldn't be written (attrs.file).

engine.started.description: The telephony engine started: attrs.engine_incarnation is the Watch stream's incarnation (the logs' own unless the clock went back), attrs.bins the zone's bins.

esl.connection_lost.description: An ESL connection to freeswitch was lost (the supervisor reconnects).

esl.cycle_failed.description: Another ESL connection attempt failed during an outage already reported (dependency.unavailable).

esl.probe_timed_out.description: No ESL probe came back within attrs.deadline_ms: the connections are presumed dead and reopened.

esl.protocol_violated.description: freeswitch sent what the ESL decoder refuses (attrs.reason): the connection is closed.

esl_event.failed.description: An ESL event (attrs.esl_event) couldn't be handled: a bug; the event is lost.

esl_event.skipped.description: An ESL event that doesn't parse (attrs.reason) was skipped.

esl_frame.ignored.description: An ESL frame of a content type TC doesn't use (attrs.content_type).

esl_reply.unmatched.description: An ESL reply came with no command waiting.

freeswitch.media_bound.description: freeswitch bound RTP ports in the canary range: it is taking media it must not (attrs.ports). Every 10 s while it lasts.

freeswitch.restarted.description: freeswitch restarted (a new Core-UUID): every leg is gone.

health_file.failed.description: The healthy file couldn't be written (counted, retried with a backoff) or removed.

hold.music_failed.description: The hold music didn't start (attrs.reason): the hold stands without music.

journal.record_dropped.description: The journal's queue was full: a record was dropped; freeswitch's CDR files remain.

journal.write_failed.description: The journal couldn't write a record.

leg.adopted_late.description: A leg freeswitch's channel listing showed only after the snapshot: adopted now.

leg.answer_failed.description: parity-ms couldn't take a leg's answer: the leg ends (MEDIA_FAILED).

leg.bridge_failed.description: The loopback carrier couldn't bridge an originated leg: the leg fails (UNREACHABLE).

leg.detach_failed.description: A leg whose DTMF codes parity-ms refused couldn't be detached from the call's media.

leg.dial_failed.description: The bridge to an originated leg's far end failed: attrs.disposition (freeswitch's cause).

leg.end_failed.description: A leg TC had to end (its customer left, or past its ring timeout) couldn't be hung up; its hook or the next sync ends it.

leg.ended.description: A leg hung up (freeswitch's hangup): attrs.role, attrs.hangup_cause, attrs.sip_status, attrs.by_tc (TC ended it).

leg.fence_write_failed.description: A raised fence couldn't be written on a new leg's channel variables.

leg.hook_failed.description: An originated customer leg's hangup hook couldn't be written.

leg.hook_mismatched.description: A leg's hangup hook didn't read back as written (R1-1): the leg ends (503), alerted.

leg.media_release_failed.description: parity-ms couldn't release an ended leg's media (detach or delete); its recording results are TC's own.

leg.refused.description: An AddLeg's agent contact was refused before dialling (TC-056): attrs.reason (tenant_mismatch or invalid_target), attrs.rule.

lifecycle_file.removed.description: A healthy or drained file left by an earlier run was removed at start (attrs.file).

log.external.description: A record of a library TC uses (Spring, gRPC, Tomcat...; component names the logger): its own text in msg (attrs.text when longer).

mailbox.overflowed.description: A session's mailbox was full: a node fact was dropped (counted) and the session resyncs from the node.

media.dtmf_actions_limited.description: parity-ms (an older release) can't lock the recording or mode with DTMF codes: attrs.dropped codes were left out (TC-048).

media.prompt_wait_refused.description: parity-ms waits for a prompt as long as TC's timeout or longer (MS-042): TC refuses to start, or refuses plays once a hello says so.

media.recording_sink_reported.description: parity-ms's hello named its recording sink (attrs.sink; attrs.tc_allows_null_sink).

media.request_refused.description: parity-ms refused a request TC sent (attrs.cmd, error.code): reported to IE as PARITY_MS_UNAVAILABLE.

media.restarted.description: parity-ms restarted (a new incarnation in its hello): every session's media is gone; the sessions are told.

media.session_ended.description: parity-ms ended a call's media itself (idle timeout, shutdown): attrs.reason; the call's legs end.

media.subscribe_refused.description: parity-ms refused the event subscription (a replay gap: the live tail is taken; the sweep reconciles).

media_call.missing.description: A first leg TC originates has no parity-ms call to attach to (TC-008): the AddLeg fails.

media_call.orphan_delete_failed.description: The sweep couldn't delete an orphaned parity-ms call; the next sweep tries again.

media_call.orphan_deleted.description: The sweep deleted a parity-ms call with no live leg in TC (two sweeps in a row).

media_sweep.failed.description: A media sweep (orphans, activity) failed; the next one runs in 5 s.

node_lock.acquired.description: This controller holds the node lock (attrs.lock_file): it is the node's only one.

node_lock.refused.description: Another controller holds the node lock (attrs.lock_file): this one refuses to start (exit 3).

node_lock.release_failed.description: Releasing the node lock failed (the process is exiting anyway).

node_lock.released.description: The node lock was released after the drain.

play.compensated.description: A play TC no longer wants (stopped, replaced, its leg left, the hold ended) was stopped by its id (the play saga's compensation, counted by attrs.reason): info when TC stops it on cancelling, warn when the play started after TC gave it up. attrs.play_wire_id is the play's id at parity-ms.

play.compensation_deferred.description: parity-ms didn't answer a compensating stop: the play stays cancelled and is stopped if it starts later (attrs.reason).

play.loop_failed.description: A looped prompt the media plays once couldn't be played again.

play.prompt_unavailable.description: parity-ms can't play a prompt of a call it has (a missing, unreadable or corrupt file): only this Play fails (PROMPT_UNKNOWN).

play.untracked_finished.description: parity-ms reported the end of a play TC doesn't track (one it gave up on): ignored.

readiness.passed.description: Every readiness check passes; the healthy file follows (service.ready).

recording.null_sink_enabled.description: The null recording sink is on (recording-sink=null; local test setups only, until R9): StartRecording records nothing.

recording.refused.description: StartRecording refused: no recording sink for this request on this node (R9); attrs.sink.

recording.result_missing.description: A recording's result didn't come from parity-ms in time: TC reports its own figures.

recording.sink_violated.description: parity-ms opened a recording file although its sink is null: stopped at once.

recording.started.description: A recording started on a leg (attrs.recording_id; attrs.sink null: nothing is written, local test setups only).

reinvite.sdp_unversioned.description: A re-INVITE changed the SDP without raising its o= version (counted).

reinvite.unanswerable.description: A re-INVITE TC can't answer (another codec, or port 0): alerted on every one (R2-5).

rpc.failed.description: A telephony.v1 call failed on an unexpected error (a bug): answered INTERNAL.

session.arrived.description: A call arrived from the edge (freeswitch parked it) and TC took it: the session exists and the arrival is offered to IE. The xsid is the interaction id from X-Parity-Interaction-Id (X-Interaction-ID until opensips moves). attrs.endpoint: SIP or WEBRTC.

session.ended.description: A call's session ended (SessionEnded is sent to IE): attrs.reason (SessionEndReason), attrs.sip_status; owner_epoch is the fence (0: no owner ever claimed it).

signal.handlers_failed.description: The signal handlers couldn't be installed: Spring Boot's shutdown hook still drains; only the exit codes differ.

signal.received.description: A first SIGTERM or SIGINT (attrs.signal): the drain starts (at once, or once the start is done).

watch.failed.description: A Watch stream failed on an unexpected error (a bug): closed with INTERNAL.
